name: mcp-web-validator
description: Validate HTML/CSS, audit SEO and JSON-LD, check links, and capture responsive screenshots.

tools.name: html.local
tools.description: Reads a bounded local HTML or .xhtml file and sends its markup to the W3C Nu HTML Checker. .xhtml files use application/xhtml+xml parsing semantics. Use only files the user is authorized to share.

tools.name: html.url
tools.description: Fetches a bounded public HTTP(S) page, then sends its markup to the W3C Nu HTML Checker. Private, reserved, credentialed, and nonstandard-port destinations are rejected.

tools.name: css.local
tools.description: Reads a bounded local CSS file and sends it to the W3C Jigsaw CSS Validator. Use only files the user is authorized to share.

tools.name: seo.metadata
tools.description: Audits supplied HTML offline for on-page SEO metadata, headings, viewport, image alternatives, and Open Graph issues. Use for a quick on-page check; use html.local/html.url for W3C HTML validation, schema.markup for JSON-LD syntax, or report.validation for a combined local-file report.

tools.name: content.duplicates
tools.description: Compares static main text across one to eight HTML pages supplied by the caller. Reports high-confidence exact matches and conservative near matches only within the same language (and script). No network requests or storage. Output is limited to this sample, not site-wide uniqueness.

tools.name: content.quality
tools.description: Offline, evidence-limited review of empty or thin static main text and substantive repeated sentences within same-language page families. Reports possible missing standalone value, not Google rankings or a semantic quality verdict. Accepts up to eight supplied HTML pages; no network, storage, browser or LLM.

tools.name: site.hreflang
tools.description: Compares head-only hreflang and canonical declarations across up to sixteen supplied static HTML pages, including x-default, reciprocal references and same-locale target consistency. No URLs are fetched, and unsampled targets are not declared broken. Works across authorized domains; no browser, files or storage.

tools.name: links.broken
tools.description: Resolves and checks up to 25 public HTTP(S) links in supplied HTML. Redirects are reported but not followed, and response bodies are discarded.

tools.name: schema.markup
tools.description: Parses JSON-LD blocks in supplied HTML locally and reports empty blocks or JSON syntax errors. It does not validate vocabulary semantics.

tools.name: report.validation
tools.description: Combines W3C HTML/CSS validation, local SEO/accessibility checks, JSON-LD syntax checks, and a bounded public-link check into a Markdown and structured report.

tools.name: audit.history
tools.description: Opt-in local-only site-audit snapshot history. Save a previous hosted audit_public_site structured result as JSON, list saved IDs, or retrieve an exact version. A single compact local JSON file retains at most 10 versions; saving the 11th removes the oldest. No database, background task, or network request.

tools.name: screenshot.capture
tools.description: Renders a local HTML file or HTTP(S) URL in a sandboxed local Chromium browser and writes PNG screenshots to the requested directory. Downloads the pinned headless browser on first use if it is not already cached. Existing matching files may be replaced. Completed PNG paths are included if a later viewport fails.

tools.name: product.claims
tools.description: Compare explicit local MCP product-page promises with this actual runtime's registered tool metadata. Supply HTML or one authorized public HTML URL. No arbitrary marketing semantics, no remote MCP credentials, no storage, no scripts and no claim of a successful tool invocation. Hosted tool claims must be verified by the hosted runtime.
